observations: For Robin: the V2 grading delta 'USB mouth X in [-1.8, -0.8]' contradicts L2.1.3's own rule (first header pin on the grid column nearest the -X edge) and the catalogue perfboard grid (grid_margin_x 4.74 -> first column at X 5.63 on a 90 mm board, giving mouth X 2.96 exactly as this design has). Meeting the delta puts the first header pin at X ~1.4-1.9, where there is no grid hole, so L3.1.6.1 would then fail (residual ~3.8 mm). Graded as written; please reconcile the delta or the grid rule.
Jacks 1 and 2 (X 21-27 and 42-48, Y 0-12) touch the Pico PCB long edge at Y = 12.0 with zero gap (interference 0 mm3, so L3.1.4.1 passes); in a real build there is no assembly tolerance there.
The corner bosses (OD 6.6 centred at (-3.29, -3.29) etc.) protrude 0.21 mm into the cavity corners; the lid lip is notched (dia 7.1) to clear them; no check is affected.

Renders live in 20261024-202830/views/ (not V2_s0/views/). model_front/model_left are viewed from slightly above, so the lid top face shows as a large red band above the base; the STLs are in the closed pose (lid plate on the rim at Z 14.2).
